description: This file contains utility functions for calculating detailed widths of dashboard components, including handling different component types such as rows, columns, charts, markdown, and dynamic components. It exports a main function 'getDetailedComponentWidth' and a helper 'getTotalChildWidth'.

methods.name: getTotalChildWidth
methods.description: Calculates the total width of all child components for a given component ID within a components map.

methods.name: getDetailedComponentWidth
methods.description: Main function that computes detailed width information for a dashboard component, considering its type and children.
